"""Project settings for the generic migration runtime."""

from copy import deepcopy
from typing import Literal

import constants
from models.deployment_models import DeploymentDefaults
from models.external_dependency import ExternalDependencyRule
from models.conversion_requirement import ConversionRequirement

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, field_validator, model_validator


class PipelineConfiguration(BaseModel):
    """Describe project inputs and conversion scope without storing credentials."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", validate_default=True)
    conversion_strategy: Literal["legacy_components", "behavior_units"] = "legacy_components"
    conversion_requirements: list[ConversionRequirement] = Field(default_factory=list)
    behavior_context_chars: int = Field(default=180000, ge=60000, le=1000000)
    source_root: str = constants.COMPOSER_ROOT
    source_workspace_id: str | None = Field(default=constants.SOURCE_WORKSPACE_ID, min_length=1)
    service_registry_path: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1)
    shared_library_min_usage: int = Field(default=constants.SHARED_LIBRARY_MIN_USAGE, ge=1)
    broad_library_usage_threshold: int = Field(default=constants.BROAD_LIBRARY_USAGE_THRESHOLD, ge=1)
    mapper_jar: str = constants.COMPOSER_MAPPER_JAR
    java_version: Literal[21, 25] = int(constants.JAVA_VERSION)
    java_home: str | None = constants.JAVA_HOME
    output_root: str = constants.OUTPUT_ROOT
    channels: list[str] = Field(default_factory=lambda: deepcopy(constants.TARGET_CHANNELS), min_length=1)
    include_operations: list[str] | None = Field(default_factory=lambda: deepcopy(constants.INCLUDE_OPERATIONS))
    exclude_operations: list[str] | None = Field(default_factory=lambda: deepcopy(constants.EXCLUDE_OPERATIONS))
    target_languages: list[Literal["java"]] = Field(default_factory=lambda: deepcopy(constants.TARGET_LANGUAGES), min_length=1)
    model_name: str = constants.AGENT_MODEL
    model_base_url: str = constants.LITELLM_BASE_URL
    auto_rerun_impacted_operations: bool = constants.AUTO_RERUN_IMPACTED_OPERATIONS
    model_provider: Literal["gemini", "litellm", "mock"] = constants.MODEL_PROVIDER
    classpath_jars: list[str] = Field(default_factory=lambda: deepcopy(constants.CLASSPATH_JARS))
    external_dependencies: list[ExternalDependencyRule] = Field(default_factory=list)
    composer_behavior_document: str = Field(default="docs/comp-manual/wsbcc_developer_manual_v2.md", exclude=True)
    maven_settings_path: str | None = constants.MAVEN_SETTINGS_PATH
    approved_maven_repository_urls: list[str] = Field(default_factory=lambda: deepcopy(constants.APPROVED_MAVEN_REPOSITORY_URLS))
    maven_local_repository: str | None = constants.MAVEN_LOCAL_REPOSITORY
    allowed_ibm_artifacts: list[str] = Field(default_factory=lambda: deepcopy(constants.ALLOWED_IBM_ARTIFACTS))
    allowed_ibm_classes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=lambda: deepcopy(constants.ALLOWED_IBM_CLASSES))
    deployment_template_dir: str | None = constants.DEPLOYMENT_TEMPLATE_DIR
    deployment_values: dict[str, dict] = Field(default_factory=lambda: deepcopy(constants.DEPLOYMENT_VALUES))
    deployment_defaults: DeploymentDefaults = Field(default_factory=lambda: DeploymentDefaults(**deepcopy(constants.DEPLOYMENT_DEFAULTS)))
    deployment_platform: str = constants.DEPLOYMENT_PLATFORM
    deployment_environment: str = constants.DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT
    deployment_env_vars: dict[str, str] = Field(default_factory=lambda: deepcopy(constants.DEPLOYMENT_ENV_VARS))
    runtime_validation_mode: Literal["disabled", "dummy"] = constants.RUNTIME_VALIDATION_MODE
    eclipse_classpath_variables: dict[str, str] = Field(default_factory=lambda: deepcopy(constants.ECLIPSE_CLASSPATH_VARIABLES))
    model_api_key_environment: str = constants.MODEL_API_KEY_ENVIRONMENT
    model_timeout_seconds: int = Field(default=constants.MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, gt=0)
    max_model_attempts: int = Field(default=constants.MAX_MODEL_ATTEMPTS, ge=1, le=10)
    max_operations_per_batch: int = Field(default=constants.MAX_OPERATIONS_PER_BATCH, ge=1)
    gate_policies: dict[str, Literal["human", "automatic", "skip"]] = Field(
        default_factory=lambda: deepcopy(constants.GATE_POLICIES)
    )

    max_agent_task_retries: int = Field(default=constants.MAX_AGENT_TASK_RETRIES, ge=1)
    max_parallel_conversion_workers: int = Field(default=constants.MAX_PARALLEL_CONVERSION_WORKERS, ge=1)
    max_parallel_llm_tasks: int = Field(default=constants.MAX_PARALLEL_LLM_TASKS, ge=1)
    max_parallel_build_tasks: int = Field(default=constants.MAX_PARALLEL_BUILD_TASKS, ge=1)
    inter_batch_delay_secs: float = Field(default=constants.INTER_BATCH_DELAY_SECS, ge=0)
    enable_git: bool = constants.ENABLE_GIT

    @field_validator("gate_policies")
    @classmethod
    def validate_gate_numbers(cls, value):
        """Reject misspelled gate numbers rather than silently defaulting their policy."""
        if set(value) - {"1", "2", "3", "4"}:
            raise ValueError("Gate numbers must be 1 through 4")
        return {**deepcopy(constants.GATE_POLICIES), **value}

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def apply_explicit_retention(self):
        """Carry explicit library retention into existing exact client dependency checks."""
        for rule in self.external_dependencies:
            if rule.treatment == "retain":
                if rule.class_name and rule.class_name not in self.allowed_ibm_classes:
                    self.allowed_ibm_classes.append(rule.class_name)
                if rule.maven_coordinates and rule.maven_coordinates not in self.allowed_ibm_artifacts:
                    self.allowed_ibm_artifacts.append(rule.maven_coordinates)
        return self

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_library_thresholds(self):
        """Require a non-empty small-sharing range between configured thresholds."""
        if self.broad_library_usage_threshold < self.shared_library_min_usage:
            raise ValueError("broad_library_usage_threshold must be at least shared_library_min_usage")
        return self

"""Generate and validate migration plans using existing planning tools."""

import json

from agents.migration_planning.agent import PLANNING_INSTRUCTION, write_migration_plan
from agents.migration_planning.plan_validator import validate_migration_plan
from models.migration_models import MigrationPlan
from runtime.model_execution.adk_executor import AdkExecutor
from runtime.model_execution.mock_executor import MockExecutor


def prepare_plan(conn, config, profile, operations) -> MigrationPlan:
    """Produce a validated plan, preserving channel identities and run ownership."""
    if profile.conversion_strategy == 'behavior_units':
        from tools.operation_call_tools.preflight import require_preflight_passed
        require_preflight_passed(conn, config.run_id)
    if not operations:
        raise ValueError("Conversion scope contains no operations")
    if profile.model_provider == "mock":
        packets = [dict(task_id=f"{config.run_id}:{item['channel']}:{item['operation_id']}",
                        run_id=config.run_id, operation_id=item["operation_id"], channel=item["channel"],
                        target_language="java", group="one_step", status="pending") for item in operations]
        batches = [dict(batch_id=f"{config.run_id}:batch:{index}", run_id=config.run_id,
                        task_packets=packets[offset:offset + config.max_operations_per_batch],
                        is_pilot=index == 0, status="pending")
                   for index, offset in enumerate(range(0, len(packets), config.max_operations_per_batch))]
        response = json.dumps(dict(plan_id=f"{config.run_id}:plan", run_id=config.run_id,
                                  batches=batches, total_operations=len(packets), unusual_count=0, status="pending"))
        executor = MockExecutor(response)
    else:
        executor = AdkExecutor(profile)
    instruction = PLANNING_INSTRUCTION.replace("{max_ops_per_batch}", str(config.max_operations_per_batch))
    instruction += "\nFor a scope smaller than three operations, include the whole scope in the pilot."
    if any(item.get('operation_dependencies') for item in operations):
        instruction += '\nRespect operation_dependencies: schedule lower build waves before their callers. Keep each circular group together and flag unresolved dependencies; do not infer that shared classes are operation calls.'
    payload = json.dumps(dict(run_id=config.run_id, operations=operations, schema=MigrationPlan.model_json_schema()))
    plan = MigrationPlan.model_validate_json(executor.execute(instruction, payload))
    packets = [packet for batch in plan.batches for packet in batch.task_packets]
    if plan.run_id != config.run_id or any(batch.run_id != config.run_id for batch in plan.batches):
        raise ValueError("Plan has incorrect run ownership")
    if any(packet.run_id != config.run_id or packet.target_language.value != "java" for packet in packets):
        raise ValueError("Plan task has incorrect run ownership or target language")
    if len({packet.task_id for packet in packets}) != len(packets):
        raise ValueError("Plan task identifiers must be unique")
    if plan.total_operations != len(packets):
        raise ValueError("Plan operation count is inconsistent")
    errors = validate_migration_plan(plan, config, conn)
    if errors:
        raise ValueError("Invalid migration plan: " + "; ".join(errors))
    write_migration_plan(conn, plan)
    return plan

"""Execute the deterministic intake stages using existing migration tools."""

from copy import deepcopy
import json
import logging
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

import constants
from agents.legacy_composer_analysis.agent import run_legacy_composer_analysis
from agents.migration_planning.agent import get_operations_for_planning
from models.pipeline_configuration import PipelineConfiguration
from tools.conversion_tools.context_hierarchy_resolver_tool import build_all_context_hierarchies
from tools.shared_artifact_classifier_tools.classifier import run_shared_artifact_classification
from tools.state_store_tools.db import create_all_tables, get_connection
from tools.state_store_tools.runs import update_run_status
from tools.workspace_intake_tools.run_factory import create_run_config, persist_run_config
from runtime.workspace_paths import resolve_run_directory, run_database_path, run_profile_path, run_report_path, run_mapper_log_path, write_run_report
from tools.source_discovery_tools import discover_java_sources
from tools.source_discovery_tools.classpath import discover_java_classpath
from runtime.model_execution.readiness import intake_model_warning
from runtime.java_toolchain import java_scope, java_environment, run_java


def run_pipeline(profile: PipelineConfiguration, run_id: str) -> Path:
    """Create a new run and prepare planning inputs; fail on an existing run directory."""
    logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    logger.info("Starting workspace intake.")
    warning = intake_model_warning(profile)
    if warning:
        print(warning)
    directory = resolve_run_directory(profile.output_root, run_id)
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    for folder in ("state", "reports", "logs", "generated"):
        (directory / folder).mkdir()
    from runtime.workflow_stages import REPORT_FOLDERS
    for stage in REPORT_FOLDERS.values():
        (directory / "reports" / stage).mkdir()
    vault = directory / "vault"
    database = run_database_path(directory)
    settings = {key: deepcopy(getattr(constants, key)) for key in dir(constants) if key.isupper()}
    settings.update(
        COMPOSER_ROOT=profile.source_root, VAULT_ROOT=str(vault),
        OUTPUT_ROOT=str(directory / "generated"), DB_PATH=str(database),
        RUN_MODE="single_channel" if len(profile.channels) == 1 else "multi_channel",
        TARGET_CHANNELS=profile.channels, TARGET_LANGUAGES=profile.target_languages,
        INCLUDE_OPERATIONS=profile.include_operations, EXCLUDE_OPERATIONS=profile.exclude_operations,
        AGENT_MODEL=profile.model_name, LITELLM_BASE_URL=profile.model_base_url,
        MAX_OPERATIONS_PER_BATCH=profile.max_operations_per_batch,
        MAX_AGENT_TASK_RETRIES=profile.max_agent_task_retries,
        MAX_PARALLEL_CONVERSION_WORKERS=profile.max_parallel_conversion_workers,
        MAX_PARALLEL_LLM_TASKS=profile.max_parallel_llm_tasks,
        MAX_PARALLEL_BUILD_TASKS=profile.max_parallel_build_tasks,
        INTER_BATCH_DELAY_SECS=profile.inter_batch_delay_secs,
        ENABLE_GIT=profile.enable_git,
        AUTO_RERUN_IMPACTED_OPERATIONS=profile.auto_rerun_impacted_operations,
    )
    config = create_run_config(settings, run_id)
    conn = get_connection(str(database))
    try:
        toolchain = java_scope(profile)
        toolchain.__enter__()
        create_all_tables(conn)
        persist_run_config(conn, config, directory)
        run_profile_path(directory).write_text(profile.model_dump_json(indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        logger.info("Discovering Java sources and classpath.")
        source_index = discover_java_sources(profile.source_root)
        run_report_path(directory, "java_source_index.json").write_text(source_index.model_dump_json(indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        if source_index.issues:
            raise ValueError("Java source discovery reported issues; inspect reports/1_intake_and_legacy_analysis/java_source_index.json")
        classpath = discover_java_classpath(profile.source_root, profile.classpath_jars,
                                           profile.eclipse_classpath_variables)
        run_report_path(directory, "java_classpath_index.json").write_text(classpath.model_dump_json(indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        from tools.component_inventory_tools import build_component_inventory
        from tools.state_store_tools.component_inventory import persist_component_inventory, get_implementation_usage, get_configured_component_usage
        logger.info("Building component inventory.")
        inventory = build_component_inventory(profile.source_root, profile.source_workspace_id, source_index)
        persist_component_inventory(conn, run_id, inventory)
        if profile.conversion_strategy == 'behavior_units':
            from tools.component_inventory_tools.service_inventory import service_inventory
            connections = service_inventory(profile.source_root, profile.channels)
            conn.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS service_definition_inventory (run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, record_json TEXT)')
            with conn:
                conn.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO service_definition_inventory VALUES (?,?)', (run_id, json.dumps(connections)))
            write_run_report(directory, 'service_definitions.json', json.dumps(connections, indent=2))
        run_report_path(directory, "component_inventory.json").write_text(inventory.model_dump_json(indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        run_report_path(directory, "java_source_dependencies.json").write_text(inventory.java_dependencies.model_dump_json(indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        run_report_path(directory, "component_usage.json").write_text(json.dumps(get_implementation_usage(conn, run_id), indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        run_report_path(directory, "configured_component_usage.json").write_text(json.dumps(get_configured_component_usage(conn, run_id), indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        command = ["java", "-jar", profile.mapper_jar, "--root", profile.source_root,
                   "--vault", str(vault), "--md"]
        if len(profile.channels) == 1 and profile.conversion_strategy != 'behavior_units':
            command.extend(["--channel", profile.channels[0]])
        update_run_status(conn, run_id, "in_progress", "mapper")
        logger.info("Running Composer mapper; output is saved in logs/mapper.log.")
        result = run_java(command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
                                env=java_environment(constants.MAPPER_JAVA_VERSION))
        run_mapper_log_path(directory).write_text(result.stdout + result.stderr, encoding="utf-8")
        if result.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError("Composer mapper failed; see logs/mapper.log")
        logger.info("Importing and analyzing the legacy vault.")
        analysis = run_legacy_composer_analysis(conn, config)
        if analysis["paused"]:
            return directory
        if profile.conversion_strategy == 'behavior_units':
            from tools.operation_call_tools.preflight import run_intake_preflight
            preflight = run_intake_preflight(conn, config, profile, directory)
            if preflight['blockers']:
                update_run_status(conn, run_id, "paused_awaiting_operator", "dependency_preflight_blocked")
                print("Dependency preflight blocked: include missing operations or resolve the reported evidence/cycles, then rerun intake. "
                      "See " + str(directory / 'reports' / '1_intake_and_legacy_analysis' / 'dependency_preflight.md'))
                return directory
        logger.info("Preparing context hierarchies and planning inputs.")
        build_all_context_hierarchies(conn, run_id)
        run_shared_artifact_classification(conn, run_id)
        operations = get_operations_for_planning(conn, run_id)
        run_report_path(directory, "planning_inputs.json").write_text(json.dumps(operations, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        update_run_status(conn, run_id, "paused", "planning_inputs_ready")
        return directory
    except Exception:
        update_run_status(conn, run_id, "failed", "intake_failed")
        raise
    finally:
        if "toolchain" in locals():
            toolchain.__exit__(None, None, None)
        conn.close()

"""Resume a persisted run through planning approval and dependency closure."""

import json
import logging

from agents.migration_planning.agent import build_gate1_report, get_operations_for_planning
from agents.migration_planning.plan_validator import validate_migration_plan
from models.common_models import RunConfig
from models.migration_models import MigrationPlan
from models.pipeline_configuration import PipelineConfiguration
from runtime.human_gates import evaluate_gate
from runtime.planning import prepare_plan
from runtime.workspace_paths import resolve_run_directory, run_database_path, run_profile_path, run_report_path, write_run_report
from tools.conversion_tools.closure_builder_tool import build_operation_closure
from tools.conversion_tools.context_field_resolver_tool import resolve_context_fields
from tools.state_store_tools._json import loads
from tools.state_store_tools.db import get_connection
from tools.state_store_tools.runs import get_run, update_run_status
from tools.source_discovery_tools.classpath import discover_java_classpath
from runtime.model_execution.diagnostics import run_model_diagnostics
from runtime.java_toolchain import java_scope


def resume_pipeline(output_root: str, run_id: str):
    """Resume planning without rerunning intake, stopping on review or blocked closure."""
    directory = resolve_run_directory(output_root, run_id)
    if not run_database_path(directory).is_file():
        raise ValueError("Run database does not exist")
    profile = PipelineConfiguration.model_validate_json(run_profile_path(directory).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    conn = get_connection(str(run_database_path(directory)))
    diagnostics = run_model_diagnostics(directory)
    diagnostics.__enter__()
    try:
        toolchain = java_scope(profile)
        toolchain.__enter__()
        run = get_run(conn, run_id)
        if run is None:
            raise ValueError("Run does not exist")
        config = RunConfig.model_validate(run["run_config_json"])
        logging.getLogger(__name__).info("Resuming saved checkpoint: %s (%s).", run["current_phase"], run["status"])
        if profile.conversion_strategy == "behavior_units":
            from runtime.conversion_strategy import resume_behavior_strategy
            return resume_behavior_strategy(conn, config, profile, directory)
        if run["current_phase"] in {"gate_4_pending", "gate_4_rejected", "finalization_blocked", "migration_approved", "dry_run_complete"}:
            row = conn.execute("SELECT plan_json FROM migration_plans WHERE run_id=? ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1", (run_id,)).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                raise ValueError("Finalization requires a persisted migration plan")
            from runtime.finalization import run_finalization
            run_finalization(conn, config, profile, MigrationPlan.model_validate_json(row[0]), directory)
            return directory
        if run["current_phase"] in {"component_review", "component_revision", "component_review_blocked", "gate_2_pending",
                                     "gate_2_rejected", "assembly_pending", "operation_assembly", "assembly_blocked",
                                     "operation_review_pending", "operation_review", "operation_revision", "operation_review_blocked",
                                     "gate_3_pending", "gate_3_rejected", "service_generation_pending", "service_generation",
                                     "service_generation_blocked", "validation_evidence_pending",
                                     "component_correction_pending", "assembly_correction_pending"}:
            row = conn.execute("SELECT plan_json FROM migration_plans WHERE run_id=? ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1",
                               (run_id,)).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                raise ValueError("Component review requires a persisted migration plan")
            if run["current_phase"] == "component_correction_pending":
                from runtime.managed_projects import run_managed_tasks
                results = run_managed_tasks(conn, config, profile, MigrationPlan.model_validate_json(row[0]))
                if results["failed"]:
                    update_run_status(conn, run_id, "blocked", "component_correction_pending")
                    return directory
            from runtime.component_review import run_component_review_gate
            phase = run_component_review_gate(conn, config, profile, MigrationPlan.model_validate_json(row[0]), directory)
            if phase == "assembly_pending":
                from runtime.operation_assembly import run_operation_assembly
                phase = run_operation_assembly(conn, config, profile, MigrationPlan.model_validate_json(row[0]), directory)
                if phase == "operation_review_pending":
                    from runtime.operation_review import run_operation_review_gate
                    phase = run_operation_review_gate(conn, config, profile, MigrationPlan.model_validate_json(row[0]), directory)
                    if phase == "service_generation_pending":
                        from runtime.service_generation import run_service_generation
                        phase = run_service_generation(conn, config, profile, MigrationPlan.model_validate_json(row[0]), directory)
                        if phase == "validation_evidence_pending":
                            from runtime.finalization import run_finalization
                            run_finalization(conn, config, profile, MigrationPlan.model_validate_json(row[0]), directory)
            return directory
        if run["current_phase"] not in {"planning_inputs_ready", "planning", "planning_failed", "gate_1_pending",
                                          "gate_1_rejected", "closures_blocked", "conversion_pending"}:
            raise ValueError("This checkpoint cannot yet be resumed by the runtime")
        operations = get_operations_for_planning(conn, run_id)
        logging.getLogger(__name__).info("Loaded %s operations for planning.", len(operations))
        row = conn.execute("SELECT plan_json FROM migration_plans WHERE run_id=? ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1",
                           (run_id,)).fetchone()
        if row:
            plan = MigrationPlan.model_validate_json(row[0])
            errors = validate_migration_plan(plan, config, conn)
            if errors:
                raise ValueError("Persisted plan failed validation: " + "; ".join(errors))
        else:
            update_run_status(conn, run_id, "in_progress", "planning")
            try:
                plan = prepare_plan(conn, config, profile, operations)
            except Exception:
                update_run_status(conn, run_id, "failed", "planning_failed")
                raise
        from tools.component_inventory_tools.library_planner import prepare_library_plan
        libraries = prepare_library_plan(conn, config, profile, plan)
        if libraries is not None:
            write_run_report(directory, "shared_library_plan.json", libraries.model_dump_json(indent=2))
        from runtime.gate_one_reports import write_gate_one_reports
        report = write_gate_one_reports(directory, conn, config, profile, plan, operations, libraries)
        decision = evaluate_gate(conn, run_id, 1, report, profile.gate_policies.get("1", "human"), libraries is None or not libraries.diagnostics)
        if decision != "approved":
            update_run_status(conn, run_id, "paused" if decision == "pending" else "stopped", f"gate_1_{decision}")
            return directory
        closures = []
        classpath = discover_java_classpath(config.source_root, profile.classpath_jars,
                                           profile.eclipse_classpath_variables)
        run_report_path(directory, "java_classpath_index.json").parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        run_report_path(directory, "java_classpath_index.json").write_text(classpath.model_dump_json(indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        for batch in plan.batches:
            for packet in batch.task_packets:
                source = conn.execute("SELECT metadata_json FROM source_artifacts WHERE run_id=? AND kind='operation' AND logical_id=?",
                                      (run_id, packet.operation_id)).fetchone()
                metadata = loads(source[0], {}) if source else {}
                context_id = metadata.get("operation_context")
                if context_id:
                    resolve_context_fields(conn, context_id, packet.channel, run_id, config.source_root)
                closure = build_operation_closure(conn, packet.operation_id, packet.channel, run_id,
                                                  config.source_root, config.vault_root, classpath_index=classpath, profile=profile)
                closures.append(closure.model_dump(mode="json"))
        write_run_report(directory, "dependency_closure.json", json.dumps(closures, indent=2))
        blocked = any(item["status"] != "READY" for item in closures)
        update_run_status(conn, run_id, "blocked" if blocked else "paused",
                          "closures_blocked" if blocked else "conversion_pending")
        if not blocked:
            from runtime.managed_projects import enqueue_closure_conversions, run_managed_tasks
            try:
                enqueue_closure_conversions(conn, config, closures)
                results = run_managed_tasks(conn, config, profile, plan)
            except Exception:
                update_run_status(conn, run_id, "failed", "conversion_pending")
                raise
            write_run_report(directory, "managed_conversion_results.json", json.dumps(results, indent=2))
            update_run_status(conn, run_id, "blocked" if results["failed"] else "paused",
                              "conversion_pending")
            if not results["failed"]:
                from runtime.component_review import run_component_review_gate
                update_run_status(conn, run_id, "in_progress", "component_review")
                phase = run_component_review_gate(conn, config, profile, plan, directory)
                if phase == "assembly_pending":
                    from runtime.operation_assembly import run_operation_assembly
                    phase = run_operation_assembly(conn, config, profile, plan, directory)
                    if phase == "operation_review_pending":
                        from runtime.operation_review import run_operation_review_gate
                        phase = run_operation_review_gate(conn, config, profile, plan, directory)
                        if phase == "service_generation_pending":
                            from runtime.service_generation import run_service_generation
                            phase = run_service_generation(conn, config, profile, plan, directory)
                            if phase == "validation_evidence_pending":
                                from runtime.finalization import run_finalization
                                run_finalization(conn, config, profile, plan, directory)
        return directory
    finally:
        if "toolchain" in locals():
            toolchain.__exit__(None, None, None)
        diagnostics.__exit__(None, None, None)
        conn.close()

"""Record CLI gate decisions using the persisted checkpoint and exact review report."""

from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3

from runtime.human_gates import record_decision
from runtime.workspace_paths import run_database_path, run_report_path


GATE_PHASES = {f"gate_{number}_{state}": number
               for number in range(1, 5) for state in ("pending", "rejected")}


def pending_gate_number(directory: Path) -> int | None:
    """Read the eligible gate number from a run without changing its database."""
    database = run_database_path(directory)
    with sqlite3.connect(database.as_uri() + "?mode=ro", uri=True) as conn:
        run = conn.execute("SELECT current_phase FROM runs WHERE run_id=?", (directory.name,)).fetchone()
    return GATE_PHASES.get(run[0]) if run else None


def record_gate_decision(directory: Path, run_id: str, gate: int, decision: str) -> None:
    """Preserve CLI eligibility checks and bind the decision to the current report content."""
    if gate == 1 and run_report_path(directory, "gate_1_report.md").is_file():
        from runtime.gate_one_reports import read_gate_one_reports
        report = read_gate_one_reports(directory)
    else:
        report = run_report_path(directory, f"gate_{gate}_report.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    database = run_database_path(directory)
    with sqlite3.connect(database.as_uri() + "?mode=rw", uri=True) as conn:
        run = conn.execute("SELECT current_phase FROM runs WHERE run_id=?", (run_id,)).fetchone()
        if run is None or run[0] not in {f"gate_{gate}_pending", f"gate_{gate}_rejected"}:
            raise ValueError("Run is not waiting at this gate")
        record_decision(conn, run_id, gate, report, decision)

source/cli/main.py.text:
"""Command-line entry point for starting and inspecting migration runs."""

import argparse
import json
import sqlite3
import uuid

from runtime.configuration import load_configuration
from runtime.pipeline_runner import run_pipeline
from runtime.checkpoints import resume_pipeline
from runtime.workspace_paths import resolve_run_directory, run_database_path
from tools.state_store_tools.runs import get_run
from cli.interactive import SelectionCancelled, complete_arguments, complete_run_selection, select_status_run, select_resume_run, select_gate_run
from cli.diagnostics import console_diagnostics
from cli.readme import open_readme
from cli.configuration_wizard import create_configuration
from cli.terminal_display import clear_screen
from runtime.model_execution.error_details import sanitize_diagnostic, print_failure_traceback
from runtime.model_execution.readiness import intake_model_warning
from cli.gate_decisions import pending_gate_number, record_gate_decision
from cli.gate_report_menu import offer_gate_one_report, offer_dependency_closure_report
from runtime.workflow_stages import workflow_stage_label
from cli.workflow_progress import display_workflow_progress


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    """Start intake or display persisted run status, returning a process exit code."""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Run generic Composer migration intake through planning inputs.")
    parser.add_argument("command", nargs="?", choices=["start", "status", "resume", "approve", "reject"])
    parser.add_argument("--config")
    parser.add_argument("--run-id")
    parser.add_argument('--connection-answers', help='JSON list of last-resort service/driver decisions for Resume')
    parser.add_argument("--gate", type=int, choices=range(1, 5))
    parser.add_argument("--verbose", "-v", action="store_true",
                        help="Enable detailed file diagnostics; keep console progress concise.")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    diagnostics = console_diagnostics(args.verbose)
    diagnostics.__enter__()
    try:
        while True:
            directory = None
            command_selected_from_menu = args.command is None
            complete_arguments(args, parser)
            if args.command == "create_config":
                create_configuration()
            elif args.command == "help":
                parser.print_help()
            elif args.command == "readme":
                open_readme()
            elif args.command == "start":
                profile = load_configuration(args.config)
                complete_run_selection(args, profile)
                run_id = args.run_id or f"run-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
                directory = run_pipeline(profile, run_id)
                if command_selected_from_menu:
                    print(f"Run created: {run_id}")
                    if getattr(profile, "model_provider", None) is not None:
                        warning = intake_model_warning(profile)
                        if warning:
                            print(warning)
                print(f"Run workspace: {directory}")
                print("Intake stopped before model-driven planning. Inspect status for the persisted result.")
                if not command_selected_from_menu:
                    return 0
                print("You may review the intake reports before continuing. Choose Resume a migration when ready to begin planning.")
                args.run_id = None
            elif args.command in {"approve", "reject"} and command_selected_from_menu:
                try:
                    directory = select_gate_run()
                    gate = args.gate or pending_gate_number(directory)
                    if gate is None:
                        raise ValueError("No gate awaiting a decision for this run")
                    decision = "approved" if args.command == "approve" else "rejected"
                    record_gate_decision(directory, directory.name, gate, decision)
                except (ValueError, OSError, RuntimeError, sqlite3.Error) as exc:
                    print(f"Migration error: {sanitize_diagnostic(str(exc))}")
                    if args.verbose:
                        print("Detailed diagnostics are saved in the run's logs folder.")
                else:
                    print(f"Gate {gate} {decision} for run: {directory.name}")
                    print("Decision recorded. Resume the run to continue.")
                args.run_id = None
                args.gate = None
            elif args.command == "resume" and command_selected_from_menu:
                try:
                    directory = select_resume_run()
                    from cli.service_connections import answer_connection_questions
                    from pathlib import Path
                    answers = json.loads(Path(args.connection_answers).read_text()) if args.connection_answers else None
                    answer_connection_questions(directory, answers=answers)
                    resumed_directory = resume_pipeline(str(directory.parent), directory.name)
                    database = run_database_path(directory)
                    with sqlite3.connect(database.as_uri() + "?mode=ro", uri=True) as conn:
                        result = conn.execute("SELECT status, current_phase FROM runs WHERE run_id=?",
                                              (directory.name,)).fetchone()
                    if result is None:
                        raise ValueError("Run not found")
                except (ValueError, OSError, RuntimeError, sqlite3.Error) as exc:
                    print(f"Migration error: {sanitize_diagnostic(str(exc))}")
                    if args.verbose:
                        print("Detailed diagnostics are saved in the run's logs folder.")
                else:
                    print(f"Resume returned for run: {directory.name}")
                    print(f"Run workspace: {resumed_directory}")
                    print(f"Saved status: {result[0]}; checkpoint: {result[1] or 'No checkpoint'}")
                    print(f"Workflow stage: {workflow_stage_label(result[1])}")
                    print("Choose View run status to inspect the result and any review requirements.")
                    if result[0] == "paused" and result[1] == "gate_1_pending":
                        offer_gate_one_report(directory)
                    elif result[0] == "blocked" and result[1] == "closures_blocked":
                        offer_dependency_closure_report(directory)
                args.run_id = None
            elif args.command == "status":
                if command_selected_from_menu:
                    directory = select_status_run()
                    run_id = directory.name
                else:
                    profile = load_configuration(args.config)
                    complete_run_selection(args, profile)
                    if not args.run_id:
                        parser.error("status requires --run-id")
                    directory = resolve_run_directory(profile.output_root, args.run_id)
                    run_id = args.run_id
                database = run_database_path(directory)
                with sqlite3.connect(database.as_uri() + "?mode=ro", uri=True) as conn:
                    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
                    run = get_run(conn, run_id)
                    if run is None:
                        raise ValueError("Run not found")
                    status = {key: run[key] for key in ("run_id", "status", "current_phase")}
                    status["workflow_stage"] = workflow_stage_label(run["current_phase"])
                    print(json.dumps(status, indent=2))
                if not command_selected_from_menu:
                    return 0
                args.run_id = None
            else:
                break
            if command_selected_from_menu and directory is not None:
                display_workflow_progress(directory)
            args.command = None
        if args.command == "exit":
            return 0
        profile = load_configuration(args.config)
        if args.command in {"approve", "reject"} and not args.gate:
            parser.error("approval commands require --run-id and --gate")
        complete_run_selection(args, profile)
        if args.command == "resume":
            if not args.run_id:
                parser.error("resume requires --run-id")
            if args.connection_answers:
                directory = resolve_run_directory(profile.output_root, args.run_id)
                from cli.service_connections import answer_connection_questions
                from pathlib import Path
                answers = json.loads(Path(args.connection_answers).read_text())
                answer_connection_questions(directory, answers=answers)
            print(f"Run workspace: {resume_pipeline(profile.output_root, args.run_id)}")
        elif args.command in {"approve", "reject"}:
            if not args.run_id or not args.gate:
                parser.error("approval commands require --run-id and --gate")
            directory = resolve_run_directory(profile.output_root, args.run_id)
            record_gate_decision(directory, args.run_id, args.gate,
                                 "approved" if args.command == "approve" else "rejected")
            print("Decision recorded. Resume the run to continue.")
        return 0
    except SelectionCancelled:
        print("Selection cancelled.")
        return 130
    except (ValueError, OSError, RuntimeError, sqlite3.Error) as exc:
        print(f"Migration error: {sanitize_diagnostic(str(exc))}")
        if args.verbose:
            print("Detailed diagnostics are saved in the run's logs folder when a run was opened.")
        return 1
    finally:
        diagnostics.__exit__(None, None, None)

"""Use the README workflow vocabulary for report locations and progress labels."""

STAGES = {
    "intake_and_legacy_analysis": "Intake and legacy analysis",
    "migration_planning": "Migration planning",
    "dependency_closure_and_component_conversion": "Dependency closure and component conversion",
    "component_review": "Component review",
    "operation_assembly_and_review": "Operation assembly and review",
    "service_generation_and_validation": "Service generation and validation",
    "final_validation": "Final validation",
}

REPORT_FOLDERS = {stage: f"{index}_{stage}" for index, stage in enumerate(STAGES, 1)}

REPORT_STAGES = {
    **{name: "intake_and_legacy_analysis" for name in (
        "run_config.json", "java_source_index.json", "java_classpath_index.json", "component_inventory.json",
        "java_source_dependencies.json", "component_usage.json", "configured_component_usage.json")},
    **{name: "migration_planning" for name in ("planning_inputs.json", "shared_library_plan.json", "gate_1_report.md", "gate_1_report.txt")},
    **{name: "dependency_closure_and_component_conversion" for name in ("dependency_closure.json", "closures.json", "managed_conversion_results.json")},
    "gate_2_report.txt": "component_review",
    "native_unit_plan.json": "dependency_closure_and_component_conversion",
    "native_bundle_results.json": "dependency_closure_and_component_conversion",
    "service_connections.json": "dependency_closure_and_component_conversion",
    "service_definitions.json": "intake_and_legacy_analysis",
    "service_connection_questions.json": "dependency_closure_and_component_conversion",
    **{name: "operation_assembly_and_review" for name in ("assembly_results.json", "gate_3_report.txt")},
    "service_validation_results.json": "service_generation_and_validation",
    **{name: "final_validation" for name in ("delivery_manifest.json", "final_report.md", "gate_4_report.txt")},
}


def workflow_stage(phase):
    """Map detailed persisted checkpoints to their containing workflow stage."""
    phase = phase or ""
    if phase.startswith(("gate_4", "finalization")) or phase in {"migration_approved", "dry_run_complete"}:
        return "final_validation"
    if phase.startswith("service_generation") or phase == "validation_evidence_pending":
        return "service_generation_and_validation"
    if phase.startswith(("operation_", "assembly_", "gate_3")):
        return "operation_assembly_and_review"
    if phase.startswith(("component_review", "component_revision", "gate_2")):
        return "component_review"
    if phase.startswith(("closure", "dependency_closure", "conversion_", "component_correction")):
        return "dependency_closure_and_component_conversion"
    if phase.startswith(("planning", "gate_1")):
        return "migration_planning"
    return "intake_and_legacy_analysis"


def workflow_stage_label(phase):
    """Return the human-facing stage name for a checkpoint."""
    return STAGES[workflow_stage(phase)]

docs/plans/operation_conversion_workflow.text:
# Operation Conversion Workflow — Staged Implementation Plan

Status: Stages 1–2 implemented; Stages 3–5 pending. The
complete sequential conversion workflow is not yet connected. The existing converter is implemented; the new work surrounds it with
intake checks, an approved run plan, shared service registration and a thin
sequential wrapper. It must not duplicate or replace the converter.

Design references: [operation-call design](../operation_calls.md),
[native converter design](../../option_two_design.md#operation-dependencies-and-approved-sequential-conversion)
and [native implementation record](../../option_two_implementation_plan.md).

## Agreed conversion-run flow

1. Select the operations/channels and the application's shared registry.
2. Intake discovers the required evidence, resolves direct and indirect CCComplex
   calls, checks dependencies and cycles, then produces the complete conversion
   plan. Missing dependencies or cycles block with details for user resolution.
3. Present intake's plan for approval before invoking the thin wrapper. This is
   one plan-approval point for the conversion run, not another gate repeated for
   every operation. Store its configured approval policy and accepted evidence.
4. The thin wrapper selects the next operation in the accepted order and invokes
   the existing conversion workflow, including packaging, tests and its existing
   four configurable gates. Wait for completion before selecting another operation.
5. Publish the successfully converted operation's callable API in the shared
   registry and save its completion in the run database before advancing.
6. On failure or pending approval, pause at that operation. Resume retains
   completed work and continues the same accepted plan.

Intake's output is a readable plan showing the selected scope, waves, operation
order, prerequisites, reused services and any blockers. Detailed Markdown and
logs remain supporting evidence. A pilot, if used, respects the same dependencies.

The run-plan approval precedes the wrapper and is distinct from the four gates
inside the existing conversion workflow. Keep those four gates and their numbers,
human/automatic/skip settings and technical checks unchanged. Reuse the existing
approval machinery for the run-plan approval; do not invent a second approval
engine. Default plan approval to human review, with a separately saved policy
using the same settings conventions. Automatic/skipped human approval never
bypasses missing dependencies, cycles or failed technical checks.

## Scope boundaries

- Reuse existing conversion, generation, assembly, packaging, operation tests,
  reviews, bounded corrections and established validation requirements.
- Add only the wrapper, registry, intake/planning changes and integration points
  needed to invoke the existing workflow for the current operation.
- Use one database per run and one shared registry database per source application.
  API-use snapshots are records inside the run database, not a third database.
- Trust completed published service contracts. Do not revalidate or reconvert a
  target for every caller, or reopen its internal conversion dependency tree.
- Block when a required operation is neither included nor published. No ignored
  dependencies, production placeholders, null substitutes or Composer fallback.
- Keep initial XML support. Record other API formats only when supported; JSON
  conversion and mock/runtime-test configuration are outside this change.
- Preserve legacy behavior, existing saved work, ownership rules, Excel generation
  and bank demo definitions. Do not silently reset or upgrade old run checkpoints.

## Development stages

These are implementation increments for the developer. They are not extra stages
or human gates executed inside every conversion run.

### Stage 1 — Shared registry and run-local records

Implement a small registry module and a typed published-service contract. Save
the source application identity and shared database location in configuration,
outside individual run directories. Keep registry access separate from the
existing run connection and its task/progress storage.

The registry maps source application/channel/operation to the successfully
converted service and API revision. Include service/artifact identity, method and
route, request/response structures and parameters, errors/outcomes, supported
media types, environment-specific address configuration and completion evidence.
Save the API definition; an optional Swagger/OpenAPI link is additional metadata.
Draft and planned interfaces stay in run state, not the completed-service registry.

Record each reused API's identity, revision, call contract and selected address
configuration in the existing run database. Later Resume uses those records;
archiving an old run must not remove its published service from the shared registry.
Do not automatically promote older run-local statuses to published completion.

Acceptance: focused storage tests demonstrate publication after completion,
lookup from a different run, application/channel isolation, and stable API-use
records without creating a third database or revalidating the target.

Stage 1 implementation record:

- Added typed completed-service contracts, completion evidence, environment
  addresses and run-local API-use snapshots. Publication requires all completion
  flags; storage validates the supplied evidence and does not execute conversion.
- Added shared SQLite publication and lookup APIs. Published revisions are
  immutable and exact repeated publication is idempotent. Existing planned or
  assembled run records are not imported as completed services.
- Added `service_registry_path` to saved profiles, reusing `source_workspace_id`
  for application identity. Native profiles default to an application-specific
  database under `work/service_registry`, independent of the run output folder.
  Explicit relative paths resolve against the profile. Loading configuration
  does not create the database. Legacy profiles without registry settings retain
  their existing behavior.
- Added immutable API-use records to the existing run connection. These retain
  the selected contract revision and address for resume; no third database is
  opened. Shared and run database roles cannot be mixed by these storage APIs.
- Focused offline tests cover completion requirements, revision preservation,
  cross-run reuse, application/channel isolation and configuration resolution.
  Automatic publication and orchestration integration remain for later stages.

### Stage 2 — Dependency preflight inside intake

Invoke a focused preflight helper from the existing intake process after source
discovery and registry lookup. Preflight is part of intake, not a separate
runtime phase between intake and conversion.

Reuse Markdown call discovery and graph calculations. Retain enough source
inventory to resolve required targets beyond channel/include/exclude filters;
the conversion selection must not silently hide dependency evidence. Resolve
identities from evidence, never by guessing another channel's operation.

Traverse dependencies of operations still requiring conversion. An included
operation needs its required conversion evidence. A published service satisfies
the dependency boundary and supplies its trusted API contract. Otherwise block,
list the missing operation and call path, and ask the user to include or resolve
it. Detect cycles, display their complete path and evidence, and request user
resolution before planning proceeds. Do not expand scope silently.

Acceptance: intake fixtures cover direct/indirect and out-of-scope dependencies,
reused published APIs, unresolved targets and cycle blocking. Failed preflight
does not invoke code generation or allow approval to bypass the blocker.

Stage 2 implementation record:

- Native intake retains the full Mapper channel inventory while keeping the
  selected conversion operations unchanged. Legacy channel filtering is unchanged.
- Preflight traverses mapped direct and indirect calls, requires omitted
  dependencies to be included or published in the shared registry, and retains
  complete call evidence and actual cycle paths. It does not guess cross-channel
  identities, expand scope, or traverse the internals of reused published services.
- Missing target notes retain their exact target identity for registry lookup;
  unresolved or conflicting evidence still blocks. Included operations also need
  their referenced mapped format evidence.
- Save the result in the existing run database and readable Markdown/JSON reports
  under intake reports. Missing dependencies or cycles pause intake for operator
  resolution before planning preparation. Planning rejects recorded blockers
  before model invocation; existing runs without preflight records retain their
  previous behavior and are not silently upgraded.
- API contracts/revisions are reported as reusable; selecting and pinning an
  environment address belongs to the later approved planning integration.
- Offline tests cover direct/indirect missing paths, exact channel resolution,
  trusted API boundaries, missing notes/formats, cycle paths, long chains,
  persistence, planning rejection and the intake runner's blocking transition.
  No new approval gate, generation, publication or sequential wrapper was added.

### Stage 3 — Intake plan output and approval handoff

After preflight passes, calculate dependency-first waves and a stable explicit
operation order using existing graph tools. Reuse the current planner and report
infrastructure; enforce dependency constraints in deterministic plan validation.
Complexity, sharing, batching or pilot selection cannot place a caller before an
operation it requires. Waves describe dependencies, not parallel execution or a
claim that conversion effort is globally optimal.

Make the plan the primary user-facing intake result. Show scope, order, waves,
prerequisites and reused API identities. Persist the full plan and its dependency
evidence in the run database. Present the run-plan approval before entering the
thin wrapper, using the saved approval policy and existing decision machinery.

Bind acceptance to the displayed plan content, including scope, graph and reused
API revisions. A material change returns to intake checks and plan approval.
Keep the four existing per-operation gate settings separate; do not renumber or
replace them with this approval. Adapt the existing review/approve commands only
where necessary to identify the run-plan approval distinctly.

Acceptance: no operation begins before plan acceptance; human mode pauses,
automatic/skip policy records the corresponding decision, and changed plan
evidence requires renewed acceptance. Dependency failures always block.

### Stage 4 — Thin wrapper around the existing conversion workflow

Persist the current operation, its existing workflow phase and completion state
in the run database. Dispatch native runs through a thin wrapper which selects
one operation from the accepted plan and invokes the existing converter with an
operation-scoped execution view. Preserve the full accepted run plan; do not
create nested conversion runs or replace it with a new single-operation plan.

Make narrow entry-point/evidence changes where existing runners process all
selected operations. Reuse their generation, assembly, service packaging,
validation and finalization implementations. Supply trusted API-use records to
CCComplex client generation and preserve the target's request, response, error
and routing contracts. Avoid re-running target conversion validation on lookup.

Run the existing four gates for the current operation with their saved policies.
Scope reports and decisions to the operation and gate so a previous operation's
approval cannot approve a different one. Pending/rejected approval or a failed
existing conversion step pauses the wrapper. Existing correction limits remain;
do not add a new runtime verification loop or approval mechanism.

Only after the current operation's complete workflow succeeds, publish its full
service record, then persist its registry reference and completion checkpoint
before advancing. An interrupted registry/checkpoint write must be recoverable
without publishing a partial contract or reconverting an already completed
service. Mark the conversion run complete only when all selected operations are
complete, not when one operation's finalization returns successfully.

Acceptance: a controlled execution trace for A -> B -> C proves that C completes
its workflow, tests, gates and publication before any B conversion begins, and B
completes before A begins. Failure or a pending gate stops progression. Resume
retains completed operations, relevant approvals and accepted shared artifacts.

### Stage 5 — Development-time verification

Test stages 1–4 with deterministic fixtures and the existing converter test
infrastructure before live conversion experiments. These tests verify the new
storage and coordination code during development; they are not an added stage
inside a conversion run and do not change operation-test policy.

Cover missing dependencies/cycles, approved order, gate settings and scoped
decisions, publication readiness, failure interruption/recovery, Resume, and two
different runs reusing a published service. Run focused regressions for the
existing entry points and legacy dispatch affected by integration changes.

After those checks pass, use the existing three-operation bank example for a
limited sequential verification and a separate-run API-reuse check. Report which
operations completed and the exact remaining blocker. Existing generator or
business-conversion failures must not turn this task into unrelated debugging.
Do not add a requirement to launch every service or enumerate every possible
chain in a large conversion run.

## Expected files to change:

The following paths are the expected implementation surface. New paths are
proposed, not files created by this documentation task. Keep responsibilities
small and confirm each increment's exact edit scope before implementation.

### New focused modules

- [converted_service_contract.py](../../source/models/converted_service_contract.py): published API record.
- [registry.py](../../source/tools/converted_service_registry_tools/registry.py): shared registry storage, lookup and publication.
- [preflight.py](../../source/tools/operation_call_tools/preflight.py): dependency-scope checks invoked by intake.
- [operation_coordinator.py](../../source/runtime/operation_coordinator.py): thin sequential wrapper only.
- [operation_progress.py](../../source/tools/state_store_tools/operation_progress.py): operation checkpoints and API-use records in the run database.

### Existing integration points

- [pipeline_configuration.py](../../source/models/pipeline_configuration.py): registry/application settings and saved run-plan approval policy.
- [pipeline_runner.py](../../source/runtime/pipeline_runner.py): intake discovery, preflight and final plan output.
- [discovery.py](../../source/tools/operation_call_tools/discovery.py): only the call-evidence extension required for out-of-scope targets.
- [planning.py](../../source/runtime/planning.py) and [plan_validator.py](../../source/agents/migration_planning/plan_validator.py): reuse planning with enforced dependency order.
- [conversion_strategy.py](../../source/runtime/conversion_strategy.py) and [checkpoints.py](../../source/runtime/checkpoints.py): dispatch and Resume through the wrapper.
- [runner.py](../../source/runtime/behavior_conversion/runner.py): current-operation entry-point integration, preserving conversion implementations.
- [service-generation runner](../../source/runtime/service_generation/runner.py), [operation evidence](../../source/runtime/operation_review/evidence.py) and [finalization runner](../../source/runtime/finalization/runner.py): scope the existing stages and evidence to the current operation.
- [operation_call_closure.py](../../source/tools/conversion_tools/operation_call_closure.py), [operation_calls.py](../../source/runtime/behavior_conversion/operation_calls.py) and [run contract storage](../../source/tools/state_store_tools/operation_calls.py): bind published API-use records without repeated target validation.
- [human_gates.py](../../source/runtime/human_gates.py), [gate_decisions.py](../../source/cli/gate_decisions.py) and [workspace_paths.py](../../source/runtime/workspace_paths.py): distinguish run-plan approval from the existing operation gates and scope review evidence correctly.

### Focused tests

- [test_service_registry.py](../../source/tests/test_service_registry.py) (new): two-run publication and lookup.
- [test_operation_preflight.py](../../source/tests/test_operation_preflight.py) (new): intake dependency and cycle blockers.
- [test_operation_coordinator.py](../../source/tests/runtime/test_operation_coordinator.py) (new): ordering, gates, interruption and Resume.
- Extend existing [planning](../../source/tests/runtime/test_planning_execution.py), [conversion](../../source/tests/runtime/test_behavior_conversion.py) and [service-generation tests](../../source/tests/runtime/test_service_generation.py) only for changed integration behavior.

## Delivery discipline

Complete and report each development stage before starting the next. Preserve
unrelated local changes. No general refactoring, new conversion pipeline, gate
renumbering, broad model-driven test campaign, automatic deployment or deletion
of Composer operations belongs to this implementation.
